description: This file defines the CodeWritePlatformService interface which specifies methods for creating, updating, and deleting codes within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: CodeWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for managing codes in the system.

methods.name: createCode
methods.description: Creates a new code with the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateCode
methods.description: Updates an existing code identified by codeId with the data from the JSON command.

methods.name: deleteCode
methods.description: Deletes the code identified by codeId.
